review_notes: restart_task adds optional override_hold and reason. Decided holds refuse ordinary restarts. Overrides require local operator/live global-supervisor authority, exact-hold fencing and audited actor/reason; undecided incidents retain ordinary restart semantics.

previous_definition.name: restart_task
previous_definition.description: Reset a completed, failed, or blocked task back to READY so it gets picked up by an agent again.

definition.name: restart_task
definition.description: Reset a completed, failed, or blocked task to READY. Recovery holds require override_hold, a reason and operator/global-supervisor authority; the release is audited.

override_hold.description: Explicitly release the recovery hold (operator/global supervisor only)

reason.description: Required reason for overriding a recovery hold
